Subject listing for notable Hy's Law / eDISH cases

Source: R/build_hyslaw_table.R
hyslaw_listing.Rd

Subject listing for notable Hy's Law / eDISH cases

Usage

hyslaw_listing(
  adsl = NULL,
  adlb = NULL,
  classified = NULL,
  which = c("notable", "all"),
  ...
)

Arguments

adsl, adlb

Passed to classify_hyslaw() when classified is NULL.

classified

Optional list from classify_hyslaw().

which

"notable" keeps peak Hy's Law, concurrent, ALP-excluded, or concurrent cholestatic subjects; "all" returns every subject.

...

Passed to classify_hyslaw().

Value

A data frame. Symptoms, alternative causes, and confirmed Hy's Law are not derived from ADLB; see footnotes on build_hyslaw_table().
